# Forty Critiques Before Wave Two

1. Reservation cannot exceed balance.
2. Duplicate reserve must deduplicate.
3. Duplicate commit must not double-consume.
4. Duplicate release must not double-refund.
5. Commit after release must conflict.
6. Release after commit must conflict.
7. Reservation keys must be scoped by user/product/action.
8. Purpose must be validated and bounded.
9. Reservations need timestamps.
10. Stale reservations need recovery policy.
11. Browser cannot choose credit price.
12. Product service cannot mutate wallet files directly.
13. Provider timeout must release or reconcile.
14. Browser close must not orphan indefinite reservations.
15. Retried provider completion must be idempotent.
16. User-key Transcribe must never charge platform credits.
17. Hosted mode must disclose cost before upload.
18. Huge media must show maximum authorized cost.
19. Cancellation behavior must be explicit.
20. Product credits must stay account-bound.
21. Purchased credits should not silently expire.
22. Promotional grants need separate provenance if introduced.
23. Marketplace badge must derive from server testimony.
24. SEO pages must never claim unavailable offers.
25. Product graph must reject duplicate identities.
26. Product routes must exist before publication.
27. App aliases must preserve old receipts.
28. Mobile purchase controls need 44px targets.
29. Safe areas must protect bottom actions.
30. Reduced motion must remove decorative transitions.
31. Focus must return after modal close.
32. Offline mode cannot imply transaction success.
33. Analytics cannot contain filenames/transcripts/content.
34. Support must trace by receipt/action id.
35. Economy metrics must distinguish reserved vs consumed liability.
36. Reward faucets need caps and idempotency.
37. Readiness failures should be CI-visible.
38. Generated marketing must remain crawlable without JS.
39. Every touched source must obey B"H/JSDoc/tab/line laws.
40. REMAINING_WORK must survive every pass and list unfinished adoption explicitly.
